title: Letter to Church Leaders in Jackson County, Missouri, 25 June 1833
handwriting: Handwriting of Frederick G. Williams and Orson Hyde
source_note: JS, Sidney Rigdon, Frederick G. Williams, and Martin Harris, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to Edward Partridge and Others, Independence, Jackson Co., MO, 25 June 1833; sent copy; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams and Orson Hyde; signatures of JS, Sidney Rigdon, Frederick G. Williams, Martin Harris, and Orson Hyde; three pages; JS Collection, CHL. Includes address, postal markings, and docket. Bifolium measuring 11 × 9 inches (28 × 22 cm) when folded. The letter was trifolded in letter style, addressed, and sealed with a red adhesive wafer. The letter included two enclosures: a “draft of the City of Zion with explanations” and a “draft of the house to be built immediately in Zion for the presidency.”1 After being delivered, the letter was refolded for filing, and Edward Partridge added a filing notation: “Letter from J. S. S. R. F. G. | W. & M. H | June 1833”. The letter has undergone conservation. This letter, along with other papers belonging to Edward Partridge, was in possession of the Partridge family until at least the mid-1880s, sometime after which it came into the possession of the Church Historian’s Office.2
